text: The loan was funded and I was under the assumption that the payments would be monthly but they were taken on my payday. The money was always taken in the morning, prior to my pay being funded, therefore, causing an overdraft! The next day or a few hours, the company returns the payment causing me higher interest fees. This was done twice before I called the company and asked for an explanation. None of the CSR 's could give me a satisfactory answer, therefore, my financial institution has a " DO NOT PAY '' for this merchant. I want to pay this loan off, but the company has fees 400 %, which is " Crazy ''!
